headline: Umber Metals wins quality award from industry association
body: Umber Metals received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Umber Metals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Umber Metals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Umber Metals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Umber Metals reported revenue growth of 15% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Umber Metals on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Umber Metals, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Umber Metals opens new production line in Windsor
body: Umber Metals commissioned a new line at its Windsor site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Umber Metals to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Umber Metals will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Windsor. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Umber Metals signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Umber Metals announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
